ref_control.spec: declared control: B_arch/model.py as committed (mlp_Z_xattn: 5 characteristics, cross-name attention, MLP, MSE, 6 epochs)

gru60_Z_mse.spec: GRU(32) on 60 sessions of [e cs-z, r cs-z, rm/vol, |e| rank] + MLP on the 5 characteristics Z; MSE on per-date rank target; 6 epochs, 16 dates per batch

lstm60_D27_mse.spec: LSTM(32) on 60 sessions of [e cs-z, r cs-z, rm/vol, |e| rank] + MLP on D trees' 27 inputs; MSE on per-date rank target; 6 epochs

mlp_D27_ic.spec: no sequence encoder: MLP on the 27 inputs only; IC loss (neg. per-date Pearson corr of standardized outputs with rank target); 6 epochs (internal no-sequence reference)

lstm60_D27_ic.spec: LSTM(32) on 60 sessions of [e cs-z, r cs-z, rm/vol, |e| rank] + MLP on 27 inputs; IC loss; 6 epochs

tcn60_D27_ic.spec: causal dilated TCN (k3, dil 1-16, residual) on 60 sessions of [e cs-z, r cs-z, rm/vol, |e| rank] + MLP on 27 inputs; IC loss; 6 epochs

tfm60_D27_ic.spec: time-axis transformer (5-session patches, 2 layers, 4 heads) on 60 sessions of [e cs-z, r cs-z, rm/vol, |e| rank] + MLP on 27 inputs; IC loss; 6 epochs

gru60_D27_ic.spec: GRU(32) on 60 sessions of [e cs-z, r cs-z, rm/vol, |e| rank] + MLP on 27 inputs; IC loss; 6 epochs

gru60_D27_ic_es.spec: GRU(32)+27 inputs, IC loss (gru60_D27_ic) with inner early stopping: up to 12 epochs, best epoch by rank IC on the last 52 training Thursdays (8-row gap; those weeks not trained on)

gru60_D27_listnet.spec: GRU(32)+27 inputs, ListNet loss (top-one softmax cross-entropy per date, target temperature 2) (gru60_D27_ic)

gru60_D27_ic_mh.spec: GRU(32)+27 inputs, IC loss (gru60_D27_ic) + extra heads on 10- and 21-session residual targets (weight 0.5 each); 5-session head predicts

gru60_D27_ic_inorm.spec: GRU(32)+27 inputs, IC loss (gru60_D27_ic) with per-window instance scaling of the e and r channels (divide by own 60-session sd, causal); coordinator note 1

gru60_D27_ic_miss.spec: GRU(32)+27 inputs, IC loss (gru60_D27_ic) + missing-indicator channel (1 where e is NaN); coordinator note 2

gru60_DC_ic.spec: GRU(32)+27 D inputs + 32 C inputs (59), IC loss (gru60_D27_ic)

gru60_D27_ic_vol.spec: GRU(32)+27 inputs, IC loss (gru60_D27_ic) + FINRA abnormal-volume rank channel (log volume minus 60-session mean; FINRA dev file, 2012+ only, 0 before)

gru60_D27_ic_reg.spec: GRU(32)+27 inputs, IC loss (gru60_D27_ic) with weight decay 1e-2 and dropout 0.3

mlp_D27_ic_es.spec: no sequence encoder: MLP on the 27 inputs, IC loss, same inner early stopping as gru60_D27_ic_es (matched no-sequence reference)

gru60_D27_ic_es_s10.spec: nominated candidate gru60_D27_ic_es re-scored with seeds 0-9, run from model.py (coordinator note 3; also the end-to-end check of model.py)
